proposed_capability: Refuse the specifically identified Chased by Death trait offer and prevent affirmative or unverified screen submissions.
player_save_control_impact: Existing opt-in and authority gates remain. The host screen adapter never sends input for the trait. Native requires exact-build locally sourced mapping, live recipient, temporary lease and an atomic submission check.
expected_outcome: One open named trait offer yields only a No thanks recommendation and can send the exact calibrated negative response in the existing port; independently correlated readback confirms the trait stayed absent.
negative_tests: A forged affirmative or confirmation stage does not execute.
Reordered IDs do not select Yes; stale capture or mislabeled/mismatched IDs hold.
Unrelated trait, absent binding, wrong recipient and player ownership fail closed.
Returned ACK cannot stand alone; no replay after uncertain effect.
rollback_path: Revert the isolated semantic trait route without changing other dialogs or the installed save.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact local EA tuning IDs, callback registration and in-game outcome for the pictured offer.
decision_rationale: Reuse the tested single-response port. Supply a closed local native map instead of guessing from the screenshot.
